newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Seal falls sharply on requotation.
newsitem.headline: Seal falls sharply on requotation.

text.p: Timber firm Seal Inc Bhd fell 32 cents within the first 15 minutes of being requoted after a 15-day suspension.
At 0145 GMT, the share was at 4.56 ringgit against 4.88 before it was suspended on June 13.
Seal announced on Thursday it was planning to diversify into property development with a 68.5 million ringgit acquisition of a 33-acre plot in central Selangor state.
It said pre-tax profit from the project was expected to be 127 million ringgit.
Brokers said they were not aware of any reasons for the selldown.
